related.title: OSIRIS-REx 小行星採樣
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：本課若要求命中機率至少 0.85，100 粒方案通過獨立模型，但不能證明整顆小行星組成。 每項結論須附輸入、單位、版本與未解限制。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: For a teaching hit target of 0.85, 100 grains pass the independent model without establishing whole-asteroid composition. Attach inputs, units, revision and unresolved limitations to each conclusion.
related.difference: 利用全程空白量化低濃度分析中的污染上限。
related.differenceEn: Quantify an upper contamination bound using process blanks in trace analysis.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 以下皆為教學假設，非實際任務參數。合成顆粒稀有成分比例 p=0.02，隨機抽取 n=50。 先按量綱手算，再以試算表獨立列式。教學名義算例：P=1−0.98^50。 結果約 0.63583 fraction。獨立隨機抽取 n 顆粒時，至少一顆稀有成分的機率=1−(1−p)^n；團聚或偏選時失效。
以下皆為教學假設，非實際任務參數。合成樣品質量 2 mg，流程空白污染 8 ng，單位換算 1 mg=10⁶ ng。 先按量綱手算，再以試算表獨立列式。教學名義算例：Cblank=8/(2×10⁶)×10⁶ ppm。 結果約 4 ppm。空白等效濃度=污染質量/樣品質量；線性混合假設不處理選擇性吸附。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: All values are teaching assumptions, not mission specifications. Use synthetic rare-grain fraction p=0.02 and n=50 random grains. Calculate by hand with units, then independently formulate a worksheet. Synthetic nominal case: P=1−0.98^50. Result ≈ 0.63583 fraction. For n independent random grains, probability of at least one rare component is 1−(1−p)^n; clustering or selection bias invalidates it.

All values are teaching assumptions, not mission specifications. Synthetic sample mass is 2 mg and process-blank contamination 8 ng; 1 mg=10⁶ ng. Calculate by hand with units, then independently formulate a worksheet. Synthetic nominal case: Cblank=8/(2×10⁶)×10⁶ ppm. Result ≈ 4 ppm. Blank-equivalent concentration=contaminant mass/sample mass; linear mixing does not capture selective adsorption.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: 國際太空站整合工程
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：本課若要求命中機率至少 0.85，100 粒方案通過獨立模型，但不能證明整顆小行星組成。 每項結論須附輸入、單位、版本與未解限制。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: For a teaching hit target of 0.85, 100 grains pass the independent model without establishing whole-asteroid composition. Attach inputs, units, revision and unresolved limitations to each conclusion.
related.difference: 用冷卻迴路熱量平衡檢查新增酬載能否由既有流量帶走。
related.differenceEn: Use a coolant-loop heat balance to assess removal of an added payload heat load.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 以下皆為教學假設，非實際任務參數。合成顆粒稀有成分比例 p=0.02，隨機抽取 n=50。 先按量綱手算，再以試算表獨立列式。教學名義算例：P=1−0.98^50。 結果約 0.63583 fraction。獨立隨機抽取 n 顆粒時，至少一顆稀有成分的機率=1−(1−p)^n；團聚或偏選時失效。
以下皆為教學假設，非實際任務參數。合成熱負載 4000 W、冷卻液比熱 4000 J/(kg K)、允許溫升 5 K。 先按量綱手算，再以試算表獨立列式。教學名義算例：ṁ=4000/(4000×5)。 結果約 0.2 kg/s。穩態 Q=ṁcpΔT；忽略相變與對外散熱，單位 W=kg/s×J/(kg K)×K。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: All values are teaching assumptions, not mission specifications. Use synthetic rare-grain fraction p=0.02 and n=50 random grains. Calculate by hand with units, then independently formulate a worksheet. Synthetic nominal case: P=1−0.98^50. Result ≈ 0.63583 fraction. For n independent random grains, probability of at least one rare component is 1−(1−p)^n; clustering or selection bias invalidates it.

All values are teaching assumptions, not mission specifications. Synthetic load is 4000 W, coolant heat capacity 4000 J/(kg K) and allowed rise 5 K. Calculate by hand with units, then independently formulate a worksheet. Synthetic nominal case: ṁ=4000/(4000×5). Result ≈ 0.2 kg/s. At steady state Q=ṁcpΔT, excluding phase change and external loss; W=kg/s×J/(kg K)×K.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
